blocks.html: Saturnalia (an agricultural deity) was an ancient Roman festival in honour of the deity Saturn originally held on December 17, and later expanded with festivities through December 23. The holiday was celebrated with a sacrifice at the Temple of Saturn in the Roman Forum and a public banquet, followed by private gift-giving, continual partying, and a carnival atmosphere that overturned Roman social norms: gambling was permitted, and masters provided table service for their slaves.

blocks.html: GOLD was a gift for royalty—in this case the chosen King of the Jews and ultimately the "King of Kings and Master of Masters" who will rule over the entire earth (Chazon/Rev 19:16). MYRRH had a much more sobering symbolism. When a person died, this perfuming agent was wrapped with the body to help cover up the stench of death. Yahushua's own body would be wrapped in linen with myrrh and aloes (Yochanan/John 19:39-40).

Yochanan the Baptist was born in the spring. According to the Mazzaroth, his cousin Yahushua was born six months later - on September 11. The shepherds came immediately; The wise men - their number is unknown - came much later.

blocks.html: Tragically, the true story should have become so badly garbled by human traditions. It's also tragic that people ignore Scripture's clear instructions and invent their own. Yahushua Himself roundly condemned religious leaders of His day who were "making the word of יהוה of no effect through your tradition" (Marqos:7:13).
